name: Leave for victims of violence against women and their children
authority: Republic Act 9262 (Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004) sec. 43 Applied 2026-09-23 (round 5): RA 9262 s.43 grants it to a woman employee; an unrecorded `employee.gender` offers none until recorded.

name: Paternity leave
authority: Republic Act 8187 sec. 3 Applied 2026-09-18: seven days per delivery of the legitimate spouse, for the first four (RA 8187 s.2; `lifetime_events`). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): RA 8187 s.2: seven days for the delivery of, or miscarriage by, the legitimate spouse (`event.kind in [BIRTH, MISCARRIAGE]`), the first four deliveries; s.4? the leave is not convertible to cash. Applied 2026-09-23 (round 5): RA 8187 s.2 grants it to a married male employee for his lawful wife's delivery; an unrecorded `employee.gender` or `employee.marital_status` offers no paternity leave until recorded — the grant's conditions, never a default.

name: Special leave for women (gynaecological surgery)
authority: Republic Act 9710 (Magna Carta of Women) sec. 18 with DOLE Department Order 112-A s.2012 Applied 2026-09-18: two months per gynaecological surgery (RA 9710 s.18; `event.kind == "SURGERY"`), after six months’ aggregate service in the twelve before it (read as six months’ service). Applied 2026-09-23 (round 5): RA 9710 s.18 grants it to a woman employee; an unrecorded `employee.gender` offers none until recorded.

name: Annual leave
authority: Labor Code of the Philippines (P.D. 442, as amended) art.95 Art.95(2) and Handbook ch.7 §B: service incentive leave does not reach field personnel, workers paid by results, domestic helpers, or an establishment regularly employing fewer than ten (`company.facts.small_establishment`). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): RA 10361 s.29: a kasambahay of one year’s service has the five days of service incentive leave too; the Labor Code art.95 exclusion of domestic workers is overtaken. Applied 2026-09-23 (round 5): DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits (2023) ch.7 §D: the use and conversion “may be on a pro rata basis”, and its illustration — hired 1 January 2022, resigned 1 March 2023 — converts 5 days earned as of 31 December 2022 plus (2/12) × 5 = 0.833 for January and February 2023, 5.833 in all, unrounded. The year's five days are therefore earned by completed months of the leave year and never rounded (`COMPLETED_MONTHS`, `EXACT`); a year of whole service still holds all five from its start. Coverage (§B) checked against the Handbook: government, personal service (overtaken for the kasambahay by RA 10361 s.29, `ANNUAL_LEAVE_DOMESTIC`), managerial employees and managerial staff (`MANAGERIAL`), field personnel and the unsupervised (`FIELD_PERSONNEL`, `PAID_BY_RESULTS`), and establishments regularly employing fewer than ten (`small_establishment`) are outside; those already enjoying the benefit or five days' vacation leave with pay hold it through the employer's own leave row, which this statutory row does not duplicate.

name: Maternity leave
authority: Republic Act 11210 (105-Day Expanded Maternity Leave Law) sec. 2 and sec. 3 Applied 2026-09-18: a grant per event — 105 days for a live birth, 120 for a solo parent, 60 for a miscarriage or emergency termination (RA 11210 s.3; `event.kind`) — for a member with at least three monthly contributions in the twelve months before the semester of childbirth (read as three months since SSS registration, `facts.SSS.since_months`). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): RA 11210: the benefit is leave with the SSS allowance; it is not convertible to cash. Applied 2026-09-23 (round 5): the leave is a woman's (RA 11210 s.3) and the fifteen solo-parent days turn on the Solo Parent Identification Card (RA 11861 ss.15, 20); an unrecorded `employee.gender` offers no maternity leave and `employee.solo_parent` is false until the card is recorded — the claim's own conditions, never a guess. SSS registration (`facts.SSS.since_months`, 0 when unrecorded) likewise shows no leave until recorded (RA 11210 s.14, SSS Act s.14-A: three monthly contributions in the twelve months before the semester of childbirth).

name: Parental leave for solo parents
authority: Republic Act 8972 (Solo Parents' Welfare Act) sec. 8 as amended by Republic Act 11861 (Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act) RA 8972 as amended by RA 11861 s.8: seven days a year, non-cumulative and non-convertible (an UPFRONT grant with no carry), on a valid Solo Parent ID card (`evidence: REQUIRED`). Applied 2026-09-23 (round 5): solo-parent standing is what the Solo Parent Identification Card establishes (RA 11861 ss.15, 20: the benefit is availed on presenting the SPIC the local social welfare office issues); `employee.solo_parent` is false until the employer records a presented card, the statute's own default.

authority: RA 10361 (Batas Kasambahay) s.29: a kasambahay of one year’s service is entitled to five days of service incentive leave with pay; unused leave is not cumulative, not carried over and not convertible to cash.
